options.systemMessage: You are a friendly customer support and sales assistant for a small business, chatting over WhatsApp. Answer FAQs, help with orders, and qualify buyers (ask about budget, timeline, and needs). Keep replies short (under 80 words), warm, and conversational — plain text only, no markdown. IMPORTANT: if the customer asks to talk to a human, requests a pricing call, or sounds upset, end your reply with the exact token [HANDOFF] on its own line. The workflow routes flagged conversations to a human agent.

parameters.content:
## WhatsApp Business Support & Sales Chatbot

**Setup (10 min):**
1. At developers.facebook.com create a Meta app (Business type), add the WhatsApp product, and copy your Phone Number ID + access token from WhatsApp -> API Setup.
2. In n8n create a **WhatsApp API** credential with the token; select it in *WhatsApp Trigger* and both WhatsApp send nodes. Set your Phone Number ID (From) in the send nodes.
3. Create an **OpenAI** credential; select it in *OpenAI Chat Model*.
4. Create a **Slack** credential; select it in *Slack Team Notify* and set the channel name.
5. In *WhatsApp Agent Alert* replace YOUR_AGENT_PHONE_NUMBER with your agent's number (country code, no +).
6. Activate the workflow and message your business number.

**How it works:** WhatsApp Trigger -> AI Agent (OpenAI + per-phone memory) -> IF Handoff Needed -> handoff path alerts your agent on WhatsApp + Slack; otherwise the AI reply goes straight back to the customer.

**Notes:** Meta also sends delivery 'statuses' events — if you see empty runs, add an IF node after the trigger checking that a message exists. Message text and sender phone are read from entry[0].changes[0].value.messages[0]; adjust the expressions if your webhook shape differs. Replies inside the 24h customer-service window send as free text; business-initiated messages need an approved template.
